summary: Mount Woodson lookout: 1936 first tower, 1950 CDF 809R tower, conflicting loss dates (1967 caption vs 1986 standing), removed by 1991; summit now communications site.

events.note: First lookout: an 80-foot battered X-brace steel tower with an Aeromotor 7x7 observation cab and a residence cabin on the ground; register says likely built by Civilian Conservation Corps crews
November windstorm blew out windows at the ranger lookout station at Woodson and set off grass and brush fires across northern San Diego County
Register's Built field gives 1948; its description dates the first tower to 1936
California Department of Forestry 809R tower: 15-by-15-foot wood cab on a 30-foot enclosed steel K-brace tower, with living quarters below the cab
State approved buying a 400-acre hilltop for the lookout and a radio repeater site
Fire broke out near the Ramona Airport on October 29, climbed the eastern slopes of Mt. Woodson and ran toward Poway, where 16 homes burned
Register photo caption reads 'Tower Lost in a 1967 Fire'; the register text says the 1950 lookout was apparently lost in a fire. The sources disagree on which tower burned
New plans drawn for a replacement tower; register has no photos or descriptions of it
A lookout is noted as standing in a 1986 survey
Last lookout demolished or removed by 1991, per register text
Registered April 13, 2009; nominated by Brad Eells

corrections.proposed: built 1936 (first lookout, an 80-foot tower); 1948 is the register's Built field value
corrections.why: The register's own description dates the first, 80-foot tower to 1936, and a hiking guide agrees. The 1950 structure is dated separately, so 1948 matches no described structure.

corrections.proposed: removal in the 1990s (Removed field reads 1990's); demolished or removed by 1991
corrections.why: The register gives a decade for the Removed field, not a single year, and its text gives 1991 as the latest date.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register's Built field gives 1948, but its description dates the first lookout, an 80-foot tower, to 1936, and a hiking guide agrees. The sources do not say whether 1948 refers to a later structure.

A photo caption says a tower was lost in a 1967 fire. The text says the 1950 lookout was apparently lost in a fire, yet a lookout was still standing in a 1986 survey. The sources do not agree which tower burned.
The register's Removed field says 1990's and its text says removed by 1991. A hiking guide places the removal in the 1980s.
The register gives 2,874 ft (876 m); the chapter gives 2894 ft (882 m). Elevation is not a facts key, so neither figure is recorded in facts.

notes_for_editor: Register's own text conflicts on the build year (1936 description vs 1948 Built field), the loss of a tower (1967 caption vs 1986 standing lookout) and removal (1990s, by 1991, 1980s per hiking guide). Brief's '1948 built' and '1990 removed' are corrected. Access set to restricted from the hiking guide's note about the gate closing at sunset; secondary source, and the summit is a communications site, so check before publishing. The 1967 fire comes from a Union-Tribune article; the excerpt read describes the fire but does not mention the lookout. No photo added: captions cited, but no image URL or licence verified.
